description.value:
Over a long rest, using artificer's implements, you can rework an unenhanced lightsaber into your own creation. It becomes an enhanced item usable only by you, requires attunement, and serves as a tech focus for your tech powers while attuned. It starts with 4 modification slots, gaining more at higher levels per the engineer table's Modification Slots column. Each modification installed beyond your proficiency bonus reduces your tech point maximum by 1. During a long rest you may install, swap, or remove modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), and any effect requiring a save uses your tech save DC.

At 9th level, you can maintain two differently modified lightsabers at once, splitting your total modification slots between them.
